verdict.rationale: Docusaurus generates static HTML/JS via `npm run build`, producing fully self-hostable output with no vendor lock-in, confirmed by first-party docs and a verified runtime scaffold/build probe. Community evidence corroborates real-world self-hosted deployments (blogs, docs sites) and even resource/performance issues that only arise from self-hosting at scale, reinforcing genuine self-host usage. Missing for 10: no explicit dedicated 'self-hosting guide' doc distinct from generic deployment instructions.
